answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The pulse of work and the mirror of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a pigment to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
